item.title: Lightning sends tree into Santa Rosa school as storm brings snow to Sonoma County mountaintop
item.description: Lightning strikes were responsible for felled redwoods that damaged a Santa Rosa school and a recycling facility and residents from Rohnert Park to Napa reported hail flurries that created shallow, snowy-looking banks by the sides of some roads.

item.title: Developer of Sonoma’s ‘fully entitled’ Montaldo Apartments project puts it up for sale
item.description: There is no listed price for the project. Instead, interested buyers are being asked to "submit offers based on the property's condition and entitlements on an 'as-is, where-is' basis."

item.title: Transcendence co-founder to return for Sonoma show featuring Broadway love songs
item.description: Stephan Stubbins, co-founder and former co-executive director of Transcendence Theatre Company in Sonoma, will collaborate with his wife, actress Libby Servais, to perform some of Broadway’s most touching, hilarious and captivating love songs in a sold-out show at Sebastiani Theatre on Friday, Feb. 20.

item.title: Girls basketball rankings: Cardinal Newman ends regular season locked at No. 1
item.description: Among local girls teams, things mostly stay unchanged again this week as most tournament games went as expected.

item.title: Sonoma Valley’s first indoor golf studio tees off
item.description: Sonoma Golf Studio, launched by Sonoma residents Amada Dougherty, and Jason and Jennifer Palter, of Boyes Hot Springs, is the Valley's first indoor golf facility.

item.title: Impact100 Sonoma receives national award for grants to mentoring alliance
item.description: Women’s philanthropic organization Impact100 Sonoma received an award this month from the nation’s leading network of women’s giving circles for its transformational support of Sonoma Valley Mentoring Alliance.

item.title: Applicants sought for Sonoma Sister Cities internship at famous Hungarian winery
item.description: The Sonoma-Tokaj Sister Cities Committeeis offering to a successful applicant for an internship at world-renowned Tokaj-Hetszolo Winery in Tokaj, Hungary, from approximately mid-August through the end of November this year.

item.title: Graduating Sonoma Valley seniors invited to submit entries for scholarship essay contest
item.description: Graduating high school seniors are invited to submit entries in the Sonoma Valley Republican Women Federated's 2026 Scholarship Essay Contest, which will award scholarships ranging from $1,000 to $5,000.

item.title: 49ers legend Jerry Rice is next Sonoma Speaker Series guest
item.description: Jerry Rice, widely regarded as the top receiver in the history of the National Football League, will be featured in a sold-out Sonoma Speaker Series event at Hanna Center in Sonoma on Monday, Feb. 23.

item.title: 1 woman killed, another critically injured in Sonoma crash
item.description: Both victims, who authorities described as older women, were hit shortly before 7:30 p.m. Tuesday by a northbound vehicle as they attempted to cross Broadway between Napa and South MacArthur streets.
